{{Quote|Yesterday, a Nallastian freighter failed to return from a trip to Esseles. Nallastian authorities contacted the Fondor Space Patrol, which sent a patrol ship to search for the freighter, starting in the area where it should have dropped out of hyperspace. But instead of finding the freighter, the patrol ship found the derelict that fit the ''Sun Runner's'' profile ... Nallastian authorities [had also] intercepted a signal from a distress beacon in space. Evidently, the beacon came from the missing freighter ...|Bultar Swan informs Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker about the Fondor Space Patrol's encounter with what appeared to be the ''Sun Runner''|<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref>}}
'''Fondor Space Patrol''' monitored the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]].

In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], a patrol ship was sent to look for a lost [[Nallastia]]n freighter that had failed to return from [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] in the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]], but instead encountered what appeared to be an ancient [[passenger freighter]], the ''[[Sun Runner]]. ''But after sending out an [[Seeker (droid)/Legends|orb-shaped messenger droid]] to report its find to [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] authorities, the Space Patrol ship itself ended up vanishing ''also''. The Space Patrol ship was later discovered by the Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] within the pressurized hangar of a [[False Sun Runner|counterfeit]] ''Sun Runner,'' held captive by a [[Force field/Legends|force field]] generated by a [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor-beam projector]]. The Space Patrol continued to aid the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in their 23 BBY [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|mission to Fondor]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Fondor Space Patrol seized the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] [[Profit (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|''Profit'']] after it was [[Skirmish at the Fondor Shipyards|captured]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] forces at the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]].<ref name="TCW:SA">''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]''</ref>
